verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a built-in Repository Agent that users direct through conversation. It is explicitly described as able to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push, which maps one-to-one onto this story; the homepage separately lists 'Code Agent' as an opt-in feature. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent's behavior, models and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as described.
